label: wage-probe2
_why: Probe 1 verified the pop-income and state-wage calls but could not SIZE the per-pop sweep: it counted its own lines and got 181 Belgian pops against 976 known from session 20260802_222826, because those lines are precisely what the log ring truncates - so the count measured the truncation. This run sizes it with `v3tb_popobj_count`, one untruncatable line per country, across all eight tracked markets. It also settles the Netherlands tag (probe 1 reported NED ABSENT in 1836, which is wrong for a country that plainly exists - the definition file says NET) and whether a state can name its own country inline, which decides whether the state-wage sweep is self-contained or needs marker-order reconstruction.
_cost: One control run, 1836.2.1 -> 1836.4.1. A couple of minutes.
